Container.Name: Pomerium Route Sync
Container.Overview: Yasha template engine used to make refreshing Pomerium routes a breeze !
Container.Description: Yasha template engine used to make refreshing Pomerium routes a breeze !
Container.Changes:
###v0.1.0 (2026-09-20) - Added opt-in WebSocket support and Host header preservation for generated routes. - Fixed authorized-domain rendering and whitespace handling.
###v0.0.1 (2022-03-21) - Initial release.

Config.Name: Pomerium Domain
Config.Description: Use the same domain as the one configured on your reverse proxy. If you use a DuckDNS wildcard domain, please put it here eg 'example.duckdns.org'

Config.Name: Pomerium Authorized Emails
Config.Description: A comma separated value (CSV) list of email adresses authorized to access Pomerium protected routes

Config.Name: Pomerium Routes
Config.Description: A comma separated value (CSV) list of routes. A route is expressed as {public HTTPS URL}=>{internal HTTP URL}, for example 'https://notes.acme.duckdns.org=>http://obsidian:3000'.

Config.Name: Allow WebSockets
Config.Description: Enable WebSocket upgrades on all generated routes. Required for applications such as LinuxServer Selkies desktops, including Obsidian.

Config.Name: Preserve Host Header
Config.Description: Pass the original public Host header to upstream applications on all generated routes.

Config.Name: Pomerium Routes Authorized Domains
Config.Description: A comma separated value (CSV) list of domains authorized to access Pomerium protected routes

Config.Name: PomeriumRouteSync templates folder
Config.Description: Path to the Jinja2 template to use to render Pomerium routes. Please find the template here https://github.com/Lowess/docker-templates-unraid/blob/main/templates/pomerium/routes.yaml.j2

Config.Name: Pomerium config
Config.Description: Pomerium config.yaml file to store rendered routes in.
